title: Overdue handoff recovery, slice 2: carrier-completion prerequisites and the land/push/install effect path with single execution and retained evidence across restart
outcome: Overdue handoff recovery, slice 2: carrier-completion prerequisites and the land/push/install effect path with single execution and retained evidence across restart
acceptance: A completed carrier (not only a registered test-run gate) with a durable next action is a handoff prerequisite and is automatically handed to a successor within a bounded time, even if its coordinator is idle or missed a wake (tests).

No land, push or install happens twice, and no evidence is dropped: tests drive the land/push/install effect path with single-execution counters and assert retained completion evidence across a host restart at each persistence cut.
The recovery owner and any overdue carrier or effect handoff are durable and observable (visible in host state or the UI and surviving a restart).
